entries.craftspeedparts.00sitaliantacho.descript: A tachometer reading up to 9.000 RPM, intended to be used in modern italian sports cars from 2000 onwards.
entries.craftspeedparts.00sitaliantacho.name: 2010s Italian Tachometer
entries.craftspeedparts.20sjapanesetacho.descrip: A tachometer reading up to 8.000 RPM, based on an instrument from Toyota GR Supra. Features a speedometer and gear counter.
entries.craftspeedparts.20sjapanesetacho.name: 2020s Japanese Tachometer
entries.craftspeedparts.90sjapspeedo.description: Indicates speed in Kilometers Per Hour. Intended to be used in most of 90s japanese cars in the pack.
entries.craftspeedparts.90sjapspeedo.name: 90s Japanese Speedometer
entries.craftspeedparts.90sjaptacho.description: A tachometer reading up to 10.000 RPM, intended to be used in most japanese cars from late 1980s to early 2000s.
entries.craftspeedparts.90sjaptacho.name: 90s Japanese Tachometer
entries.craftspeedparts.classic_us_speedo.descri: Indicates speed in Kilometers Per Hour. Intended to be used in classic american cars.
entries.craftspeedparts.classic_us_speedo.name: Classic US Speedometer
entries.craftspeedparts.classic_us_tacho.descrip: A tachometer reading up to 6000 RPM, intended to be used in most classic american cars.
entries.craftspeedparts.classic_us_tacho.name: Classic US Tachometer
entries.craftspeedparts.genericbattery.descripti: Can be used in anything, this is pack's generic gauge for monitoring battery status if you need it.
entries.craftspeedparts.genericbattery.name: Battery level Generic Gauge
entries.craftspeedparts.genericoilpressure.descr: Can be used in anything, this is pack's generic gauge for monitoring oil pressure if you need it.
entries.craftspeedparts.genericoilpressure.name: Oil Pressure Generic Gauge
entries.craftspeedparts.genericwatertemp.descrip: Can be used in anything, this is pack's generic gauge for monitoring overall engine temperature if you need it.
entries.craftspeedparts.genericwatertemp.name: Water Temperature Generic Gauge
entries.craftspeedparts.moderngermanspeedo.descr: Indicates speed in Kilometers Per Hour. Meant to be used in anything german made past 2000.
entries.craftspeedparts.moderngermanspeedo.name: Modern German Speedometer
entries.craftspeedparts.moderngermantacho.descri: A tachometer reading up to 10.000 RPM, intended to be used in all kinds of german cars made after 2000.
entries.craftspeedparts.moderngermantacho.name: Modern German Tachometer
entries.craftspeedparts.modernusspeedo.descripti: Indicates speed in Kilometers Per Hour. Intended to be used in modern american cars.
entries.craftspeedparts.modernusspeedo.name: Modern US Speedometer
entries.craftspeedparts.modernustacho.descriptio: A tachometer reading up to 7000 RPM, intended to be used in modern (post-1990) american cars.
entries.craftspeedparts.modernustacho.name: Modern US Tachometer
entries.craftspeedparts.retroeurospeedo.descript: Indicates speed in Kilometers Per Hour. Fits the most in european cars from late 70s to early 90s.
entries.craftspeedparts.retroeurospeedo.name: Retro European Speedometer
entries.craftspeedparts.retroeurotacho.descripti: Reads up to 10.000 RPM, based on Italian designs but can be used basicly in anything from late 70s to early 90s.
entries.craftspeedparts.retroeurotacho.name: Retro European Tachometer
entries.craftspeedparts.us_fuel_gauge.descriptio: Indicates fuel - supposed to be used in American cars.
entries.craftspeedparts.us_fuel_gauge.name: US Generic Fuel Gauge
